entries.label: 2026 provincial/territorial brackets, by upper threshold (upper null = no limit)
entries.notes: 2026 notes: BC 2026 budget raised lowest rate from 5.06% to 5.60%. AB indexation capped at 2.0%. MB brackets paused - no indexation since 2025 (bracket creep active). NS indexation began 2026 (1.6%). PE: no indexation; new 20% top bracket from Jan 1, 2026. ON $150k/$220k thresholds NOT indexed; other ON thresholds indexed 1.9%. QC indexation 2.05%. NL 8 brackets; indexation 1.1%. 2027 brackets land ~Dec 2026.
entries.source_note: KPMG 'Federal and Provincial/Territorial Income Tax Rates and Brackets for 2026' (current as of June 30, 2026). Big-4 publication cross-checked 2026-09-27 vs TurboTax, Fidelity, Lifemoney, Waypoint Budget, paycheckguru for ON. Primary ministry tables were not individually re-pulled this run; treat KPMG as near-official.

entries.label: Quebec federal tax abatement
entries.notes: 16.5% reduction off federal tax for QC residents. Quebec uses its own TD1/source-deduction formulas.
entries.source_note: mbtaxsolutions 2026-09 guide + income-tax-estimator research. Quebec files a separate return with Revenu Quebec.

entries.label: Ontario 2026 surtax tiers (on basic provincial tax)
entries.notes: True top ON provincial marginal = 13.16% x 1.56 = 20.53%; top combined federal-provincial = 53.53%. Surtax starts biting around ~$95k income. Only jurisdiction with a surtax structure; the calculator library implements it in ontarioAddOns().
entries.source_note: RCGT Table I1 Ontario 2026 (updated April 30, 2026); corroborated by paycheckguru, immigrationnewscanada, mbtaxsolutions, marginal-vs-average-tax research (Python-verified).

entries.label: Ontario Health Premium 2026
entries.notes: $0 to $900 depending on taxable income; kicks in above $20,000. Not indexed.
entries.source_note: mbtaxsolutions Sept 2026 guide + RCGT Table I1. Used in marginal-vs-average worked examples ($600 at $48k-$72k, $750 at $72k-$200k).
